mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 235.0 signals accelerating inflation, which triggers monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 235.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% and employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 135000.0 thousand persons, the labor market tightens, signaling strong economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0 AND PAYEMS > 135000.0 (i.e., returns positive in <60% of cases) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime (defined by FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 235.0), strong economic growth and investor confidence produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 235.0 (i.e., returns positive in <60% of cases) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity and supply chain health, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 100.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900.0 thousand units, it signals strong demand for housing and the broader economy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 900.0 (i.e., returns positive in <60% of cases) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential sales volume (RSAFS) indicates strong demand for housing and the broader economy, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS > 427000.0 (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 7.0%, it signals a weak labor market and economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 7.0 (i.e., returns negative in <60% of cases) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
